The '''Felucian Rancor''' was a type of [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Felucian rancor is a playable rancor in the "Rancor Rampage" in [[Kinect Star Wars]].
